da7bb886-7e6b-4174-83a9-2c478475b846.title: Isekai Yakkyoku
da7bb886-7e6b-4174-83a9-2c478475b846.description:
When a young pharmacologist gives his life to his research and dies from overwork, he finds himself reincarnated as a boy named Farma, the son of a court physician. In this new world where faulty remedies run rampant, Farma uses his knowledge of modern pharmacology and his cheat powers to cure all of the diseases around him. (Edited One Peace Books)
___
**Character Designer:** [keepout](https://mangadex.org/author/d9694ff3-185d-429c-831e-82f06199d427)

85a8ebda-9959-4244-ad03-a2d9f6a746a2.title: The Swordmaster's Son
85a8ebda-9959-4244-ad03-a2d9f6a746a2.description:
Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began.

Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster!

63a76f81-0e64-47b6-b8d7-4feda78c10f1.title: Reijou wa Mattari wo Goshomou.
63a76f81-0e64-47b6-b8d7-4feda78c10f1.altTitle: My Lady Just Wants to Relax
63a76f81-0e64-47b6-b8d7-4feda78c10f1.description: Dia bekerja mati-matian di kehidupan masa lalunya, tetapi kemudian dia dilahirkan kembali di dunia lain sebagai sang penjahat Ronia! Seperti dalam cerita, pertunangannya hancur dan dia dikeluarkan dari masyarakat kelas atas, tapi sekarang dia mengambil kesempatan itu untuk hidup dengan damai, dan bahkan membuka sebuah kafe di desa terpencil dengan bantuan teman-teman perinya, yang secara tak terduga menjadi populer di kalangan para beast-kin…

a68cfed3-3c1a-4ad7-99a9-80b9018377f6.title: I Will Become a God
a68cfed3-3c1a-4ad7-99a9-80b9018377f6.description: Shin runs a shaman detective agency that solves any problem for money. To save his younger sibling, he needs 10 billion won but has no idea how to come up with the money. An evangelist, Ji-yul, tries to recruit him on the street to join the Gwangcheon Church. An idea suddenly comes to him... to become the cult leader of Gwangcheon Church and swallow up the 10 billion won!

5052c6c1-561b-42d4-a7b1-9ce502d07e3d.title: Myo'oden Rei
5052c6c1-561b-42d4-a7b1-9ce502d07e3d.altTitle: Legend of the Wisdom King: Rei
5052c6c1-561b-42d4-a7b1-9ce502d07e3d.description: Idols in the entertainment industry are possessed by living spirits. The cause is said to be the transformed thoughts of their fans. When their minds become exhausted, it manifests as physical ailments, and eventually becomes a spiritual affliction that ravages their bodies. What is Rei's cure?

bb9e0255-0cf5-4b04-9cff-57761ea72772.title: Kannami Kyoudai no Kunan
bb9e0255-0cf5-4b04-9cff-57761ea72772.description:
A twin body-swapping BL!

Seikain Academy is an institution for the children of the elite. Amongst its students are twins Ouri and Himeri, who differ from each other in every way imaginable. The eldest twin, Ouri, is a listless member of the soccer club, while his younger sister, Himeri, is on the honor roll and serves as an assistant to the student council. Suddenly, a twist of fate causes them to switch bodies. In order to switch back, Ouri must seduce Tsukasa Houdou—the student council president—while in his sister's body! Meanwhile, Himeri discovers her brother's secret crush...?

a29bd145-116e-49c8-bc2f-b15857299304.title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu
a29bd145-116e-49c8-bc2f-b15857299304.description:
New adaptation of the 1980s novel series.

Five hundred years ago, Rudolf von Goldenbaum united the disparate governments of humankind and established a mighty human empire, a tribute to his own greatness that stretched across the galaxy. Demanding loyalty and discipline, Rudolf created an order designed to long outlast his own rule; but all human works fade in time. Today, the decaying empire faces the threat of the Free Planets Alliance and military leaders on both sides jockey for power in the face of a seemingly inevitable conflict. On the side of the empire, the young general Reinhard von Lohengramm sees war as an opportunity, and the empire as soft clay ready for his own sculpting. On the side of the alliance, would-be historian Yang Wen-li would like nothing better than to live out his days in peace - but times of war have little use for men who waste their days studying the mistakes of the past. Circumstances will make heroes and villains of both these men, as they write new history one blood-splattered page at a time.
  


---

If you teach martial arts to 100,000 warriors, only one or two of would become true swordsmen...

486c4a96-ccbb-47f3-959e-f2d5d97c54cf.description: A feud? A dating rumor? What's the drama between the hottest member of DOT, Yoon-chan, and the leader of the group, Kang Sol?

5824397c-5337-418d-9612-7331b03b0fd2.title: Ducks Are The Best!
5824397c-5337-418d-9612-7331b03b0fd2.description:
A mysterious duck chases Jiwoo, who dropped her wallet on the street. 
Jiwoo takes the duck into her home, and the duck quickly becomes immersed in their new home. And so begins... the days of the duck race!

633ba7a3-0109-4e2f-babb-df6556de8b77.title: Returning Student
633ba7a3-0109-4e2f-babb-df6556de8b77.description: Im Cheol, who was a legend in middle school, returns to school to seek revenge after learning that his friend Kim Sol, committed suicide due to school violence. However, his revenge is disrupted when Seo Ha-Yoon, who was like an older sister to him in the orphanage, is assigned to the same school as his teacher.

7f025527-d5e9-4497-8916-3aae59e320f0.title: The Roommate Agreement
7f025527-d5e9-4497-8916-3aae59e320f0.description: Lately, Yeji's life has been less up and more down. She's barely making ends meet with a dead end part-time job, school's been rough, and her roommate is the worst. Moving in with an old friend just meant that after a year, she had one less friend. Things quickly take a turn when her roommate/former-friend/"frenemy" announces she'll be moving out. Too bad Yeji's new roommate wasn't exactly what she was hoping for.

0da358e6-37b7-4068-b1d7-100e4344485d.title: Isekai Shounin - Skill <Isekai Tokou> wo Kushi Shite, Yuuyuu Jiteki na Okanemochi Slow Life wo Okurimasu
0da358e6-37b7-4068-b1d7-100e4344485d.altTitle: Isekai Merchant: Living a Rich Slow Life with <Isekai Travel>
0da358e6-37b7-4068-b1d7-100e4344485d.description: One day, the protagonist Allen, who has been reincarnated from Japan into another world, realizes that his unique skill, Moon Gate, allows him to travel freely between Japan and the other world. With this power, Allen comes up with the idea of traveling between Japan and the other world and making money by selling various items to people from the other world, those who have been transferred, and those who have been reincarnated, who are hungry for entertainment! Before long, he gets to know the daughter of a large company and the princess of a kingdom in the other world, and enjoys the other world to the fullest...!!

fd56d1e7-2851-4648-9c41-e23b1b37cdf6.title: Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Gakeppuchi Reijou wa, Teikoku no Koutei Denka to Musubareru
fd56d1e7-2851-4648-9c41-e23b1b37cdf6.altTitle: Twice Rejected, Now I’m Engaged to the Empire’s Dark Prince?!
fd56d1e7-2851-4648-9c41-e23b1b37cdf6.description: Exiled from society for a crime she did not commit, a duke's daughter, Minerva, was heartbroken after two broken engagements and had given up on marriage. One day, while being scorned and exposed to the public at a tea party, she meets Rufus, the second prince of the empire, who is feared as "His Imperial Highness, the Prince of Jet Black." Minerva, who was admired for the way she behaved resolutely without losing her pride, is proposed to by Rufus and…?

b6622d86-74c6-47eb-8c92-89bcce50a63b.title: OUT
b6622d86-74c6-47eb-8c92-89bcce50a63b.description:
17-year-old Iguchi Tatsuya has just been released from juvenile detention and is on probation. He's been relocated to a new area, away from the bad influence of his old friends, and is under the care of his aunt. He is determined not to be sent back to lockup, and he works hard in his aunt's restaurant. However, he still has the same personality, the same tendency to violence, and still falls in with the same sort of people. It's going to be difficult for him to stay out of trouble.
___
**Official English:** [emaqi](https://emaqi.com/manga/out) - United States & Canada only.

de0c8b12-2721-4a7c-a43e-82e452d62b9c.title: Akuyaku Reijou ni Onee ga Tenseishita kedo nanimo Mondai ga Nai Ken
de0c8b12-2721-4a7c-a43e-82e452d62b9c.altTitle: An Onee Reincarnated as a Villainess, but There’s No Problem
de0c8b12-2721-4a7c-a43e-82e452d62b9c.description:
I, a plump Onee, walked around drinking in Ni-chōme, got drunk, and after that met with an accident and scattered my life…… was supposed to have happened. But you see, when I woke up, I had reincarnated into the beautiful duke’s daughter Elizabeth~!

Eh? But the role is the villainess, you say? A joke, surely!

Rather than that, isn’t it about using this beauty to make a lover who is a gorimacho of my taste! Seriously!

While putting tsukkomi into this too-loose world and rampaging with knowledge cheat, Elizabeth is strongly approached by a slender ikemen prince who is the complete opposite of what the person herself desires-

a2b129f7-9374-47b1-aff5-12aab7b6c74b.title: Kitsune to Pancake
a2b129f7-9374-47b1-aff5-12aab7b6c74b.description:
Little girls that look like little animals – Kon-chan, as well as her friends Baru-chan and Yume-chan. They live in the care of a human father in order to grow up, and have a very fun and exciting daily life.  
  
A wonderful, cute, soft and fluffy story.
